meta.title: Cepa Sur — Family and corporate governance

hero.title: Cepa Sur
hero.lead: Family and corporate governance for those who protect a legacy, bring order to decisions, and safeguard what matters most.

familyGov.title: Family Governance
familyGov.lead: Wealth and the enterprise endure across generations when family rules are written with clarity, discussed with respect, and upheld over time.
familyGov.body: We work with business families that need a framework for living with the company without confusing affection and interest. The process is private, tailored, and oriented toward agreements that can actually be kept.

points.title: Family protocol
points.text: Agreements on ownership, family employment, dividends, and the resolution of conflict.

points.title: Succession
points.text: Preparing the next generation and the transfer of roles with explicit timelines and criteria.

points.title: Family and wealth
points.text: Family governing bodies that speak with the board and protect a shared purpose.

corpGov.title: Corporate Governance
corpGov.lead: A board that works, controls that are understood, and decisions that are recorded distinguish a lasting company from one that depends on a single person.
corpGov.body: We advise companies, family groups, and boards seeking to institutionalize decision-making without losing agility or the character of the organization.

points.title: Boards
points.text: Composition, working methods, evaluation, and the relationship with management and shareholders.

points.title: Controls and transparency
points.text: Policies, information for governance, and practices that sustain internal trust.

points.title: Institutional continuity
points.text: Structures that allow growth, partnership, or succession without improvising governance.

company.title: The firm
company.lead: Cepa Sur is a boutique advisory firm in family and corporate governance.
company.body: We operate with small teams, a clear mandate, and complete discretion. We are not a mass-market firm: we accept few engagements in order to accompany them in depth. Our work takes place off the public stage — in boardrooms, family councils, and conversations that require reserve.

values.title: Reserve
values.text: Nothing entrusted to us circulates beyond the mandate.

values.title: Measure
values.text: Each process is designed for that family and that company, not for a catalogue.

values.title: Seriousness
values.text: Written agreements, realistic timelines, and a direct relationship with those who decide.

team.title: Team
team.lead: A small core of partners and advisers, experienced in governance, business families, and boards.
team.note: Final profiles will be published with each member’s authorization.
